title: How we selected the research sample
framing_note: These are research selection steps, not investment conversion or app drop-offs.

steps.label: Completed Mains survey stage (MAIN_COMP_STATUS)
steps.why: Only Mains-completers were asked the detailed occupation, product-consideration and holdings questions this study depends on.

steps.label: Gen Z (Life_Stage; age 18-28 per SEBI Main Report Annexure)
steps.rule: Life_Stage == “Gen Z” (ages 18–28 per the SEBI Main Report Annexure)
steps.why: The research question is specifically about Gen Z respondents.

steps.label: Salaried occupation (Q14 in documented Salaried set)
steps.rule: Q14 (occupation) is one of the 9 values the SEBI Main Report Annexure documents as “Salaried”
steps.why: The research question is specifically about salaried respondents; classification follows SEBI's own published occupation buckets rather than an inferred reading of the label.

detail.excluded_breakdown: 18,892 respondents fall into SEBI-documented non-salaried buckets (Business, Non-worker, Self Employed, Agriculture & Allied, Skilled Worker, Unskilled Worker) — see the occupation table below.

ambiguous_breakdown.label: Others (Specify) — free-text catch-all, not named in the SEBI Annexure
Service (Urban) & CWE Education 10 to Graduate — sibling Rural version is listed as Salaried, this Urban combination is not
Service (Urban) & CWE Education illiterate to 9th standard — same reasoning

detail.ambiguous_note: 1,338 = 1,320 + 13 + 5. These 3 groups are kept distinct and are excluded from the confirmed Salaried group, not assumed either way.

steps.label: Considers mutual funds (Q23A contains MF token)
steps.rule: Q23A's tokenized answer contains the literal “Mutual Funds (One-time Lumpsum / SIP)” option
steps.why: Identifies respondents who report considering mutual funds — the population the research question is about.

detail.excluded_breakdown: 2,901 respondents answered Q23A but did not include the mutual-fund option — they reported considering other products instead.
detail.unknown_breakdown: 892 respondents have a blank Q23A (not administered/not answered). Investigated directly: this 892 group's QFL Investor share (55.2%) and mutual-fund holding rate (32.6%) are close to the 3,454 respondents who did answer Q23A (56.7% and 32.9%) — so this blank group does not look systematically different on those two measures — but 891 of the 892 (99.9%) are also blank on the related Q25A field, consistent with a routing gap rather than a recorded ‘no’.

steps.label: Interpretable holding status and does not hold MF (Q22A_All)
steps.rule: Q22A_All gives an interpretable answer (not blank, not the explicit “Not Answered”) that does not contain the MF option
steps.why: Confirms current non-holding of mutual funds specifically — an unclear Q22A_All response is treated as unknown, never assumed to mean non-holding.

broader_group_holding_status_note.text: Separately from this funnel: within the broader group (n = 4,346), 3 respondents have an unknown mutual-fund holding status (blank or explicit “Not Answered” on Q22A_All). This is a distinct measure — the current-MF-holding-share calculation for the broader group — not a step in the funnel above, since the focused group (step 5) is itself defined by requiring an interpretable Q22A_All.
